issues.message: No sources, ports, TFSF, or waveguide/Floquet/MSL ports configured. Simulation will produce zero fields.

geometry[0] 'pec' cannot be realized on this lattice and run()/forward() will raise: PEC volume 'pec' (Cylinder) rasterizes to ZERO cells on this grid: no primal-cell centre lies inside it, so it would silently vanish (the #369 vaporized-metal class, now an error). A filament (a via or post thinner than a cell) is a PolylineWire, not a volume; a volume needs a radius of at least ~0.87 of the local cell (half the cell diagonal) to be sure of one centre — resolve the mesh or redraw the body. (lattice ownership contract #931 §1.5; preflight reports it here so the whole configuration is audited before the raise).
